ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high-intensity (white/light grey) macro-patch on the distal left lobe, approximating an 80:20 distribution ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch located on the outer 40% of the left lobe; multiple discrete circular high-intensity spots (mottling) scattered across the medial and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left trailing edge; right trailing edge exhibits irregular, larger-amplitude peaks and valleys, specifically near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory on both lobes, curving significantly upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel and unaligned linear rake marks visible as dark disruptions within the left lobe's white patch and light grey lines on the right lobe's dark surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged indentation on the distal-most edge of the left lobe; irregular notch/tissue loss on the upper-right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical high-intensity (white) streak originating from the center of the median notch and extending toward the peduncle base.
